about: The shared pool: the colours every pane may name, by use, each with the colour it paints where a theme sets none, what a terminal shows for it -- its default colours for text and grounds, a pane's frame in grey (`bright black`), else the nearest of its sixteen inks -- and the character a terminal fills a shape with in it. These defaults are the window's own palette, night's.

colors.name: ground
colors.about: the medium's own ground: what shows where nothing is drawn

colors.name: background
colors.about: opaque, empty material beneath content

colors.name: text
colors.about: ordinary authored material

colors.name: quiet
colors.about: present, deliberately quiet

colors.name: accent
colors.about: the one thing being pointed at

colors.name: alert
colors.about: something the weaver must see

colors.name: guide
colors.about: a mark a guest set for the weaver to see, never Workshop's own voice

colors.name: edge
colors.about: a box's quiet outline, where a weaver types

colors.name: surface
colors.about: a card, a band or a header: material raised over the background

colors.name: field
colors.about: where a weaver types or a value sits, sunk below the background

colors.name: chosen
colors.about: the ground of a chosen row

colors.name: veil
colors.about: a translucent cover over what is not the subject; a terminal draws none

colors.name: soft
colors.about: words beside the text: readable, and quieter than text

colors.name: faint
colors.about: fainter than quiet: what is there but empty, and outlines of what cannot be pressed

colors.name: warn
colors.about: what must come first, short of an alert

colors.name: done
colors.about: ready, running or done

colors.name: frame
colors.about: a pane's chrome: its edge and its header

colors.name: frame_selected
colors.about: the selected pane's chrome

colors.name: frame_transient
colors.about: the chrome of a surface over a pane for a while: a menu, a dialog

colors.name: primary
colors.about: the face of the press offered first

colors.name: on_primary
colors.about: words on the face of the press offered first

colors.name: secondary
colors.about: the outline and words of a press offered second

colors.name: background_alt
colors.about: a second background, for regions that stand apart from the background beside them
